# SkillTreq

> SkillTreq is a free skill tracker that visualizes bodyweight skills as a dependency tree. Users can see prerequisites, log workouts, follow training plans, and track real progress. Available as a progressive web app at skilltreq.app.

SkillTreq is designed for calisthenics athletes, acrobats, and anyone training bodyweight skills. Instead of gamification or streak-based motivation, it focuses on structured data and honest progress tracking.

Key features:

- **Skill Tree**: Skills displayed as a dependency graph. Each skill has prerequisites — users see exactly what to train next.
- **Training Calendar**: Structured training plans with scheduled workouts.
- **Active Workout**: Step-by-step guided sessions with timer, reps, and holds.
- **Progress Tracking**: Activity heatmap, skill stats, and personal records.
- **Coach System**: Client management, plan assignment, and activity monitoring for coaches.

SkillTreq is free during Beta. No credit card, no trial. Available in English, Slovak, and Czech.

- Website: https://www.skilltreq.com
- App: https://www.skilltreq.app
- Contact: hello@skilltreq.com
